'''Carp''' is a [[fish]] that can be caught in the [[The Mountain#Fishing|mountain lake]] or [[Farm Maps|Wilderness Farm]] during [[Spring]], [[Summer]], or [[Fall]]. It can also be caught in the [[Secret Woods]], [[The Sewers]], or the [[Mutant Bug Lair]] during any season. It can also be gifted by a [[Animals#Pets|pet]] cat with max [[Animals#Friendship|friendship]]. It can also randomly be found in [[Garbage Can]]s during Spring, Summer and Fall, or at the [[Traveling Cart]] for {{Tprice|30}}.

Carp is always most abundant in the Secret Woods, comprising between 41% and 53% of all items caught there when it isn't raining.<ref name="spawnrate" />

==Tailoring==
Carp can be used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the [[File:Shirt157.png|24px]] [[Tailoring|Fishing Vest]]. It can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as a yellow dye in the dye pots, located at [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house [[2 Willow Lane]].

==Fish Pond==
Carp can be placed in a [[Fish Pond]], where they will reproduce every day. The initial pond capacity is 3 fish, but the capacity can be increased to 10 by completing two quests. The only possible output is yellow Carp [[Roe]].

==Quests==
*'''Item Delivery:''' One Carp may be randomly requested during [[Spring]], [[Summer]], or [[Fall]] at the [[Quests#Help Wanted Quests|"Help Wanted" board]] outside [[Pierre's General Store]] for a reward of {{Price|90}} and 150 [[Friendship]] points.
*'''Fishing:''' [[Demetrius]] or [[Willy]] may randomly request 1-5 Carp to be caught during [[Spring]], [[Summer]], or [[Fall]] at the [[Quests#Help Wanted Quests|"Help Wanted" board]] outside [[Pierre's General Store]] for a reward of {{Price|30}} per fish.  (You get to keep the fish).
*Two Carp may be requested by [[Dorado]], [[Lingcod]], or [[Pike]] in a [[Fish Pond#Quests|Fish Pond quest]] to increase the capacity of the pond from 3 to 5.

==Note==
*Carp are one of the easiest fish to catch, rarely moving past the 3rd bar on the fishing meter in the fishing mini-game, making it easy to get "Perfect" on its catches.
